name: Image Stitcher
description: Combine multiple images into one, side by side, in a column or a grid, with spacing, background color and transparency
help: Everything runs in Rust on your machine; files never leave your computer.
Images are stitched in the order added; use move up / down to rearrange them.
Horizontal strips align top / center / bottom, vertical strips align left / center / right, grid cells are centered.
PNG and WebP keep transparency; JPEG has none, so a transparent background becomes white.
